⚡ Quickstart Guide

Authenticate requests by passing your API key as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

cURL Example:
curl https://api.nexus-ai.dev/v1/chat/completions \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer nx_live_YOUR_API_KEY" \
  -d '{
    "model": "nexus-4-turbo",
    "messages": [
      {"role": "system", "content": "You are a master architect."},
      {"role": "user", "content": "Design an event-driven Kafka pipeline."}
    ],
    "temperature": 0.7
  }'

🐍 Python SDK Integration

Install the client library: pip install nexus-ai

import nexus

client = nexus.NexusAI(api_key="nx_live_YOUR_API_KEY")

response = client.chat.completions.create(
    model="nexus-4-turbo",
    messages=[
        {"role": "user", "content": "Build a React 19 hook for biometric auth."}
    ],
    stream=True
)

for chunk in response:
    print(chunk.choices[0].delta.content or "", end="")
